title: Requester IPs removed from feed events
summary:
A quieter text API day: less requester data in feed events, clearer Poly instructions, and updated request controls.

Text API feed events no longer include the requester's IP address.

Poly's prompt now states an October 2023 knowledge cutoff and permits a Pollinations footer in commercial-blog-style content.

IP blocking and rate-limit handling were updated, including referrer handling for ai-ministries.com. The model-context wrapper also gained a way to pass an override model name to its generator.
